# Feature: Conveyor tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #2 (Conveyor tile) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: Carries you one tile per move; you only get off where it ends. Unique: the belt's direction, one tile per move, even if you move across it. Useful: drift you must fight or ride where exits are scarce. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** carries you one tile per move; you only get off where it ends.

**So that** drift you must fight or ride where exits are scarce.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Conveyor tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-2-conveyor-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: two belts meet on a normal tile, one running to the exit and one to a hazard. A player who steps onto the first belt without reading its arrow is carried off it with no way to step off sideways and is returned to the checkpoint, which teaches that the route is chosen on the normal tile before the belt takes over. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Step onto the belt and at the start of each move it carries you one tile in its arrow direction
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: While on the belt you cannot step off sideways
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: You get off only where the belt ends on a normal tile, so from a normal tile surrounded by belts you read the arrows ahead and choose which belt to enter

## Edge Cases & Rules

- While on the belt you cannot step off sideways
- You get off only where the belt ends on a normal tile, so from a normal tile surrounded by belts you read the arrows ahead and choose which belt to enter
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Conveyor tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-2-conveyor-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #2.
